references.observed: Bronze-grey deep elongated body with large gold-edged scales, upturned mouth and forward barbels, conspicuous subdued silver iris, long pale pectorals, posterior dorsal/anal and rounded brown tail.

limitations: Original bronze/gold Scleropages formosus visual study based on the inspected National Institute of Ecology photograph. Ornamental colour varieties differ. Teeth and fine head plates are simplified; the swim loop is artist-tuned, not measured behavior.
